---
pagetitle: "Krishnagopal Halder"
page-layout: full
toc: false
listing:
  - id: Journal-articles
    template: ejs/publication_yearly_home.ejs
    contents:
    - publications/publications.yaml
    max-items: 3
    sort: "year desc"
    field-display-names:
      summary: "Summary"
    field-types:
      summary: raw
  - id: Beyond-papers
    contents:
      - publications/other_outputs.yaml
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4
    max-items: 4
    fields: [image, title, description, categories]
  - id: Presentations
    contents:
      - presentations/*.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4
    max-items: 4
    date-format: "MMM YYYY"
    fields: [image, date, title, event, location]
  - id: Posts
    contents: posts/*.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4
    max-items: 4
    date-format: "MMM YYYY"
    fields: [image, title, description, categories, date]
---
